notes: For each target, maximum_hold_seconds = allocation_seconds - minimum_train_seconds - allocation_reserve_seconds.

The delayed source trigger is exactly source_minimum_train_seconds - maximum_hold_seconds. source_minimum_train_seconds includes startup, checkpointing and other wall-time overhead; raw step-time products are not a safe source-completion forecast.
The final evaluation continuation submits exactly one 16-node normal holder with a delayed after dependency.
Trigger times are measured from the source Slurm allocation start.
No debug timer job is used, preserving the debug-qos two-submit ceiling for evaluation and supervision.
A holder may wait only while minimum training time plus a 20-minute reserve remains.
